baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transitive focus verb at word 3 acts directly on the unprotected person named at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forceful driving meets a person already defined by severance from a protector. The act therefore does more than fail to repair vulnerability: it actively repeats and intensifies the orphan's constitutive separation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies rough, forceful thrusting and makes the predicate an enacted expulsion rather than passive neglect.
Supplies a child cut off from parental protection, so the thrust compounds an already broken protective relation.

changed_reading.before: He is harsh to the orphan or sends the orphan away.
changed_reading.after: He actively re-enacts orphaning: force is used to drive an already unprotected dependent farther from access, belonging, and protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb's split mapping holds both forceful driving and speech that draws someone near, while its object is socially isolated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposed branch directions create a relational reversal. A person who most needs to be called into proximity is instead propelled outward; exclusion becomes the corruption of an available summons.

activation_trace.role: Contributes outward force and supplies the expelling pole of the reversal.
Contributes calling that draws near and supplies the unrealized relational alternative to expulsion.
Contributes solitary disconnection, making nearness versus further isolation the mechanism's decisive axis.

changed_reading.before: The line depicts a one-directional shove.
changed_reading.after: The shove is the inverse of hospitality and summons: the isolated person who should be drawn into relation is deliberately driven out of it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A chiding-herding branch of the focus verb converges with the object's branch of singular, peerless isolation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The act can be carried as social reduction: a singular person is handled as a steerable unit, moved by rebuke rather than addressed as a claimant or relation. The reading coexists with literal bodily force but shifts attention to dehumanizing command.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the chiding call used to drive a herd and frames the action as coercive management by voice.
Supplies isolated singularity, highlighting the violence of reducing an irreducible person to movable stock.
Supplies small dependents as a branch image and keeps the coercive management attached to the focus object's dependency.

changed_reading.before: The orphan receives an isolated act of rough treatment.
changed_reading.after: The orphan is coercively managed and de-personed: singular vulnerability is treated as a troublesome dependent category to be driven along.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding summons to attend, attribution of falsification, and account/recompense convert the focus action into visible evidence. Treatment of the least protected person functions as the bodily ledger in which a hidden rejection becomes inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the observable forceful act that can bear evidentiary weight.
Supplies the unprotected test case whose treatment exposes the actor's operative commitments.
Supplies attention-directing inquiry and turns the next action into the requested object of recognition.
Supplies active attribution of falsity and frames rejection as a stance manifested through conduct.
Supplies accounting and recompense, allowing the social act to register as an entry in a moral ledger.

structural_cues: The attention-command in 107:1 is answered by the deictic identification at the start of 107:2.
The repeated relative construction binds an abstract rejected commitment to a concrete action and actor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attention, falsification, accounting, force, and unprotectedness; I infer the arrow from conduct to disclosure, while a live alternative is that 107:2 merely gives one example without making it an exhaustive diagnostic.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a cruel act.
changed_reading.after: The cruel act is a public fingerprint of an otherwise hidden denial: the orphan's treatment becomes the place where the actor's real account is made visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus split root supplies the assertion of a right or affiliation; the context supplies discrediting and debt. Physical expulsion can therefore enforce a prior discursive move: mark the vulnerable claimant false so that kinship, property, or care obligations never enter the account.

activation_trace.role: Supplies claiming a right or affiliation and makes the focus object legible as a bearer of a denied claim.
Supplies the force that physically executes exclusion after the claim is refused.
Supplies loss of the normal protector who could validate or enforce the claim.
Supplies the act of imputing falsehood and functions as the discursive foreclosure of the claim.
Supplies financial indebtedness and renders care or property as an obligation the actor refuses to recognize.

structural_cues: The abstract object of rejection in 107:1 is followed immediately by a vulnerable human direct object in 107:2.
The orphan's lack of a protector makes denial of standing materially effective rather than merely verbal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies right-claim, false-attribution, debt, and force; I infer that discrediting a claim enables expulsion, while the live alternative is a broader rejection of accountability with no specific legal dispute.

changed_reading.before: The actor drives away a socially weak child.
changed_reading.after: The actor first makes the orphan's claim socially unreal, then makes the claimant physically absent; the shove is enforcement of denied standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts abundant coercive energy toward the orphan with absent motivating energy toward feeding the poor. This is not simple apathy: social force is selectively vectored, pushing vulnerability away while refusing to move others or resources toward relief.

activation_trace.role: Supplies strong outward propulsion and establishes that the actor is capable of forceful initiative.
Supplies the first unprotected recipient toward whom force is directed.
Supplies vigorous urging and, under negation, marks the missing counter-force that could mobilize care.
Supplies feeding another and gives the withheld social motion a concrete destination.
Supplies abject need and links the second vulnerable person to the orphan's exposure.

structural_cues: A positive forceful verb in 107:2 is followed by a negated urging verb in 107:3.
Both clauses direct attention to vulnerable human objects, but the direction of agency reverses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward force, negated urging, feeding, and abjection; I infer a shared force-budget whose direction reveals preference, while the live alternative is simply two independent failures placed in sequence.

changed_reading.before: The actor is callous or inactive toward vulnerable people.
changed_reading.after: The actor is highly active, but only in the wrong direction: force expels need, while no force is spent mobilizing nourishment toward it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus applies violent motion to a person whose care is already delayed; the context couples livelihood with loss of motion and sustenance that stabilizes a dwelling. The paradoxical result is that imposed movement produces social immobility by removing access to what lets a person remain and recover.

activation_trace.role: Supplies imposed bodily or social motion and initiates the displacement mechanism.
Supplies delayed care and makes deprivation temporal as well as relational.
Supplies livelihood and well-being as the resource base removed by exclusion.
Supplies cessation of motion and names the disabling endpoint of resource deprivation.
Supplies sustenance that fixes residence and clarifies what would permit stable belonging.

structural_cues: The focus verb moves a person away; the following clause names food and a person marked by diminished capacity.
The orphan branch already encodes care arriving late, so the sequence can be read temporally as accumulating disablement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, delayed care, livelihood, stasis, and stabilizing sustenance; I infer that exclusion from resources converts forced movement into reduced agency, while a live alternative is that motion and stasis remain separate images.

changed_reading.before: The shove merely removes the orphan from one place.
changed_reading.after: The shove removes the conditions of stable agency: outward displacement and delayed provision make the vulnerable person less able to move, dwell, or recover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer branches supply supplication, blessing, and mercy, while heedlessness supplies failure of inward attention. Against them, the focus verb's split call-near branch and literal thrust expose a reversal: ritual speech draws mercy near in form while embodied conduct drives its human addressee away.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a call that draws near and creates the relational action ritual mercy would be expected to perform.
Supplies the contrary bodily action, turning invocation into expulsion.
Supplies the unprotected human recipient through whom claimed mercy can be tested.
Supplies prayer as supplication, praise, and mercy and establishes the ritual pole of the contradiction.
Supplies blessing and mercy from the non-dominant mapped root, reinforcing relational beneficence rather than mere ceremony.
Supplies inward heedlessness and explains how ritual language can fail to redirect embodied conduct.

structural_cues: The sequence turns from vulnerable bodies and food to prayer, inviting conduct to read ritual rather than remain a separate topic.
The call-versus-drive opposition is internal to the focus root mapping and is sharpened by prayer's mercy branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calling-near, thrusting-away, mercy, and heedlessness; I infer that conduct tests whether ritual invocation has become relational action, while a live alternative is that the prayer group is a parallel type rather than strictly the same individual.

changed_reading.before: The orphan's expulsion is a social fault beside a separate ritual fault.
changed_reading.after: The expulsion is the embodied falsification of ritual mercy: the mouth calls blessing near while the body drives its possible recipient away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening directs sight toward the actor, and the later occurrence supplies ostentatious visibility. Forceful displacement of an isolated person can then be read as scene management: remove need from the field while placing the pious self inside it.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the physical force capable of editing who remains present in the social scene.

Supplies making something visible and frames the actor's self-presentation as selective revelation.

structural_cues: The sight root appears at the opening and again after the prayer sequence, enclosing the treatment of the vulnerable within a visibility frame.
The focus action has a spatial direction, making removal from a viewed scene mechanically available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed attention, display, force, and isolation; I infer the spatial arrow that expulsion edits the visible scene, while a live alternative is that ostentation concerns only worship and does not motivate the earlier shove.

changed_reading.before: The actor wants the orphan gone.
changed_reading.after: The actor curates visibility: need is pushed out of frame so that a polished religious self can occupy the frame uncontested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final roots supply a withheld hand, a barrier, and assistance. They generalize the focus shove from an episode into boundary infrastructure: body, hand, and resource all enforce the same rule that aid must not cross toward the dependent.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the bodily push as the first enacted boundary against access.
Supplies the dependent already lacking a protector and therefore most exposed to an access barrier.
Supplies the hand deliberately held back from giving and extends bodily rejection into resource withholding.
Supplies a barrier between a person and what is sought, making exclusion a durable arrangement.
Supplies assistance and names precisely what the barrier prevents from reaching the vulnerable person.

structural_cues: The surah's final paired verbs and object repeat the focus pattern of an agent actively obstructing a vulnerable person's access.
The movement runs consistently away from relation: push the person out, hold the hand back, retain the aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shove, withheld giving, barrier, and aid; I infer that these are scales of one exclusion system, while a live alternative is a list of related but operationally separate acts.

changed_reading.before: The shove is a moment of personal cruelty.
changed_reading.after: The shove is the bodily edge of an aid-denial system: exclusion is reproduced through space, gesture, and control of ordinary assistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The orphan branch names lost protection, while the prevention branch includes strength that protects against penetration. The actor has protective capacity but turns it around: strength guards possessions and boundaries from the orphan instead of guarding the orphan from exposure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the absence of a protecting parent and establishes protection as the focus object's missing relation.

Supplies protective strength that cannot be penetrated and reveals the actor's capacity to construct safety.

structural_cues: The focus object is defined by missing protection; the closing prevention image supplies protection used as exclusion.
The same actor-position is associated with force against a person and strength around retained goods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lost guardianship, force, defensive strength, and aid; I infer a reversal in the object of protection, while a live alternative is that the protective-strength branch remains a remote analogy to ordinary withholding.

changed_reading.before: The orphan suffers because no protector is present.
changed_reading.after: The orphan is orphaned again by a social protector in reverse: available strength fortifies resources against the child instead of sheltering the child.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The recovery-call branch is surprising because it is formulaic and not the ordinary sense of the focus verb. It remains anchored in the same focus root and converges with the object's lost support: speech that should help a fallen person rise is inverted into force that keeps an unsupported person down. Render only as a contained reversal, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 3 carries both severe thrusting and a formula addressed to a stumbler, while word 4 names someone without ordinary support.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a restorative cry to a stumbler and creates the help-to-rise pole of the reversal.

changed_reading.before: The actor knocks or drives the orphan away.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the line stages anti-rescue: the verbal space that could tell the unsupported person to rise is converted into the force that makes rising harder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The graft image is cross-domain and therefore surprising, but it remains anchored through the orphan's focus branch of isolated singleness and the focus verb's expulsion. The context branch contributes acceptance of union as the live counter-mechanism. Render as a botanical social analogy, never as the lexical meaning of feeding or thrusting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Force at focus word 3 preserves the solitary condition named by focus word 4 instead of allowing incorporation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the rejecting force that prevents incorporation.
Supplies isolated singleness and defines the social condition that a successful joining would change.
Supplies a branch accepting a graft and models nourishment as successful union with a sustaining body.

changed_reading.before: The orphan is excluded from an encounter or portion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the orphan is treated as a graft the social stock refuses to receive; expulsion preserves isolation by blocking nourishing union.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The report and handsome-appearance images come from the non-dominant split mapping of the visibility root, so the mechanism is branch-distant. It remains worth carrying because context explicitly activates public display and the focus supplies spatial removal of an isolated person. Render as an exploratory account of narrative and visual curation, not as a claim that the context verb lexically means reporting or beautifying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus action can remove a solitary witness or visible need from the actor's social field.

activation_trace.role: Supplies forceful removal and gives reputational editing a concrete spatial operation.
Supplies isolated singularity and makes the vulnerable person an easily omitted counter-image.
Supplies transmission of a report and activates control over the story others receive.

changed_reading.before: The actor removes an unwanted person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the actor removes the counter-story: visible need is expelled so a handsome public account of the self can circulate without contradiction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packed-container branch of the focus verb is materially remote, but it is focus-root anchored and becomes coherent beside livelihood, barriers, and aid. The reader-supplied arrow is that resource enclosure treats social space like a vessel packed by displacing a weak claimant. Render as a contained scarcity or accumulation analogy, not as a lexical substitution for the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root at word 3 includes agitation used to make a vessel take more, and its object at word 4 is marked by delayed care.

activation_trace.role: Supplies shaking a container until it packs full and models accumulation through rearrangement and pressure.
Supplies delayed care and identifies who is displaced when accumulation takes priority.
Supplies livelihood and well-being as the material contents around which enclosure operates.
Supplies the barrier that keeps packed resources from crossing toward a claimant.
Supplies assistance as the excluded flow that would otherwise open the container outward.

changed_reading.before: The actor pushes away a person while separately retaining small goods.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, person-removal and resource-retention form one packing logic: social space is compressed around possession, and delayed care is what gets shaken out.

strongest_changes: The focus action became active re-severing: force repeats the orphan's prior loss of protection.
The opening context turned the shove into visible evidence and, separately, into enforcement of a discredited right or debt claim.
The next verse exposed asymmetric social force: strong propulsion expels need while no counter-force mobilizes nourishment toward it.
Prayer and public display recast expulsion as embodied falsification of mercy and as selective control of who remains visible.
The closing withholding roots revealed a durable aid barrier and an inversion in which protective strength guards resources from the unprotected person.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's split inventory kept force, summons, and right-claim alive together rather than collapsing them. Context then activated distinct evidentiary, kinetic, ritual, visual, legal, and resource mechanisms. Remote but anchored branches also preserved anti-rescue, refused-graft, reputational-editing, and packed-container readings as qualified outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The summons and claim readings use the non-dominant split mapping of the focus root and should remain coexisting activations, not substitute glosses.
The report and attractive-appearance outlier uses the non-dominant split mapping of the visibility root and is materially more distant than the direct ostentation model.
The sequence supports but does not prove strict identity between the focus actor and every later prayer or display subject; type-level continuity remains possible.
Causal arrows from denied accountability to expulsion, from display to scene-clearing, and from resource enclosure to displacement are abductive rather than explicitly stated.
The stumbler, graft, and packed-container models are branch-grounded analogies whose value lies in changed reading, not lexical disambiguation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The orphan is physically and legally thrust away.** Evidence: `د ع ع B001` rough thrusting or forceful driving, `ي ت م B001` offspring cut from protecting parent; activated by `م ن ع B002` barrier between a person and what he seeks in 107:7. Structure: pushing comes early; explicit withholding comes last. Mechanism: the push is not only bodily harshness but the creation of a barrier between the orphan and due support. Abductive move: I supply the connection from physical force to social/legal exclusion; the packet supplies thrust, orphan-cutoff, and barrier branches. Reading change: يدع اليتيم reads as active displacement from protection, not merely rudeness.

2. **Orphaning as intensified isolation.** Evidence: `ي ت م B002` isolated singleness/peerless separation, with `ي ت م B004` delay in care; activated by `س ك ن B003` household inhabitants and `م ع ن B006` dwelling/stopping-place. Structure: household/dwelling roots later define what the orphan lacks. Mechanism: the denier converts a child already cut off into a socially un-housed solitary figure. Abductive move: I infer that the later domestic lexicon casts the orphan as excluded from household circulation. Reading change: the ayah becomes about isolating the vulnerable from the house, not only pushing one child.

3. **Resource-packing without mercy.** Evidence: `د ع ع B002` agitating a vessel until it fills; activated by `ط ع م B004` provision/livelihood and `م ع ن B005` small available benefit. Structure: the same root that can move a container toward fullness appears in an ayah about pushing away need. Mechanism: goods can be packed and retained while the dependent is driven off. Abductive move: I supply the economic inversion: movement that should help a vessel receive becomes social violence that keeps resources inside. Reading change: يدع becomes a pressure of hoarding as much as a shove.

4. **Heedless shortfall around the orphan.** Evidence: `ي ت م B003` heedlessness/falling short and `ي ت م B004` delayed kindness; activated by `س ه و B001` heedlessness in 107:5. Structure: later “heedless of prayer” echoes a dormant orphan-root branch. Mechanism: ritual inattention and social delay are the same posture of missed attention. Abductive move: I infer a parallel between failure to attend to prayer and failure to attend to the orphan; the packet supplies both heedlessness branches. Reading change: the orphan ayah becomes an early sign of the later prayer-defect.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later `س ه و B001` surprised me by activating `ي ت م B003/B004`: orphan-care is delayed or missed before prayer is missed. The final `م ن ع B002` also clarified the shove as barrier-making, not only momentary violence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The thrust actively reproduces orphanhood.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ع ع/B001` is rough thrusting, harsh driving, and pushing someone away from a due right; fixed `ي ت م/B001` is offspring cut off from a protecting parent. **Structural cue:** `فذلك` makes this action the identifying consequence of 107:1, while 107:3 and 107:7 continue the pattern of blocked provision. **Assigned role:** the thrust is not incidental violence; it extends the orphan's prior severance into a present social exclusion. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies bereavement, force, and later withholding; I infer that driving the child away causes continued loss of substitute protection. **Reading change:** the subject does not merely encounter an orphan but helps manufacture the orphan's ongoing social isolation.

2. **Force used for expulsion is the inverse of force used for filling.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ع ع/B002` is agitating a measure, vessel, or sack until it fills; 107:3 supplies `ط ع م/B002`, feeding another, and 107:7 supplies `م ع ن/B005`, small household benefit, gift, or alms made available. **Structural cue:** rough movement of the child is followed by refusal to mobilize food and finally by withholding useful goods. **Assigned role:** the vessel branch supplies a material logistics model in which motion should make provision fit and become full. **Abductive move:** the packet does not equate the child with a vessel; I infer a directional reversal: the agent applies force to eject a dependent where social force could instead organize filling and supply. **Reading change:** `يدع` becomes an anti-provisioning action, displacing the recipient rather than arranging resources around the need.

3. **A restorative cry is darkly reversed.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ع ع/B004` is the cry said to a stumbler, “rise” or “recover,” while fixed `ي ت م/B004` includes kindness delayed from the orphan. **Structural cue:** the same root that can accompany raising a fallen person here governs the orphan as the object of a harsh transitive act; later non-urging and withholding prolong the delay. **Assigned role:** the recovery branch marks the help that this encounter could have supplied. **Abductive move:** the packet does not call the orphan a literal stumbler; I infer social stumbling from lost protection and postponed care. **Reading change:** `يدع اليتيم` reads as the reversal of restoration: an occasion to raise the exposed person is converted into renewed rejection.

4. **`اليتيم` names a condition that society can maintain.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ي ت م/B002` is isolated singleness, and fixed `ي ت م/B004` is slowness or delay in care. **Structural cue:** after the initial loss encoded by the noun, 107:3 adds failure to exhort, 107:5 adds heedlessness, and 107:7 adds active withholding. **Assigned role:** singleness describes the social position; delay describes the temporal process that keeps it in place. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies repeated omissions by the surrounding group, but the arrow from those omissions to sustained isolation is my inference. **Reading change:** “orphan” is not only a static biographical status; the ayah exposes an orphaning process continually renewed by delayed communal care.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 107:3 first exposed a reversal I could not see from the thrust alone: the force of `د ع ع/B002` that can pack a vessel toward fullness is followed by refusal to mobilize food. 107:7 then completed the correction by making delayed care (`ي ت م/B004`) an active blockade, showing that the push is one moment in a longer system of sustained isolation rather than a self-contained outburst.

findings.text: İtme, koruyucusunu yitirmiş çocuğun önceki kopuşunu yeniden üretir ve onu hak ettiği desteğin önünde kalıcı bir engelle karşı karşıya bırakır.
Bir kabı doldurmaya yarayabilecek hareketin tersine, burada güç kaynakları ihtiyacın çevresinde toplamak yerine ihtiyaç sahibini uzaklaştırmak için kullanılır.
Düşeni ayağa kaldıran bir çağrının tersine çevrilmesi gibi, korunmasız çocuğu toparlama fırsatı yeni bir geri çevirmeye dönüşür.
Yetimlik burada yalnız biyografik bir durum değildir; geciken bakım ve yinelenen dışlama, çocuğun toplumsal yalnızlığını sürdüren bir yetimleştirme sürecidir.
Yetimle ilgili gecikme ve eksik kalma boyutu, sonraki namaz umursamazlığıyla aynı dikkat bozukluğunu açığa çıkarır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Feeding the Vulnerable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dependent child or poor person is placed before an agent who either thrusts the recipient away or mobilizes food on the recipient's behalf.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: orphaned child (ي ت م:B001/m01); forceful rebuff (د ع ع:B001/m01); exhortation toward food and good (ح ض ض:B001/m01); food as sustenance (ط ع م:B001/m02); feeding another (ط ع م:B002/m01); poor and humbled recipient (س ك ن:B006/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The orphan and the poor person occupy the recipient role, food is the transferable object, and exhortation is the social action that should set provision in motion. The violent shove reverses that process by turning proximity to a dependent into expulsion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Religious obligation becomes visible through prayer, mercy, and social response, while denial, neglect, and display place the actor before reckoning and consequence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Prayer spans ritual performance, blessing, divine mercy, personal solace, and exposure to punitive heat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Negligent and Ostentatious Observance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ritual action remains publicly visible while attention leaves the act and concern shifts toward the gaze of other people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prescribed ritual prayer (ص ل و:B003/m01); lapse within prayer (س ه و:B001/m02); general neglect and shortcoming (ي ت م:B003/m01); ostentatious display (ر ء ي:B005/m01); deceptive action (ك ذ ب:B001/m02)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و), 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The body preserves the recognizable form of prayer, but attention has withdrawn and the act is redirected toward spectators. Neglect names the inner absence, ostentation names the social orientation, and deceptive action names the gap between visible observance and operative purpose.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Watered Pasture and Cattle Feed
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Flowing water sustains summer plants and abundant pasture, grazing animals consume the forage, and nourishment appears in bodily fat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: flowing visible water (م ع ن:B001/m01); summer water plant grazed by cattle (د ع ع:B008/m01); camel forage grass (ص ل و:B009/m01); pasture that prevents migration (س ك ن:B010/m02); livestock fat and marrow condition (ط ع م:B007/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water produces a grazing zone durable enough to halt migration. Aquatic plants and tufted grass pass into the herd as nourishment, with fat and marrow marking the outcome of successful pasture.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Famine Seed and Grinding Slab
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wild edible seed is gathered under scarcity and reduced on a broad stone into usable food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wild famine seed (د ع ع:B010/m01); black-ant lookalike (د ع ع:B010/m02); grinding slab (ص ل و:B008/m01); food as sustenance (ط ع م:B001/m02); productive livelihood (ط ع م:B004/m03)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The seed supplies an emergency food object, its ant-like form aids recognition, and the slab supplies the processing tool. Scarcity thus produces a compact gathering-and-pounding scene rather than an abstract notion of provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An actor controls access or escape by shoving, restraining, trapping, fortifying, or refusing entry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repulsion and withheld aid extend into battlefield resistance, hunting capture, defended settlements, and personal chastity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Forceful Exclusion and Reciprocal Struggle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One actor drives another away or toward danger, while opposing force turns unilateral coercion into a contest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: forceful shove and rebuff (د ع ع:B001/m01); coercive redirection (د ع ع:B001/m02); battle incitement (ح ض ض:B001/m02); reciprocal resistance (م ن ع:B006/m01); choking restraint (ط ع م:B012/m02); coercive domination (د ي ن:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Shoving, incitement, and throat restraint place force directly on a body. Reciprocal resistance changes the relation from expulsion to struggle, while domination names the durable hierarchy that coercion seeks to produce.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Chastity and Guarded Personal Access
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woman without a spouse maintains bodily and social boundaries through refusal and guarded access.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: chaste refusal (م ن ع:B004/m01); woman without a spouse (ي ت م:B005/m01); menstrual indication (ر ء ي:B007/m01); self-directed resolve (ح ض ض:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 يَحُضُّ (ح ض ض), 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Marital status, bodily indication, and deliberate refusal define a guarded personal sphere. The resistance sense of prevention becomes self-protection rather than an obstacle imposed by an external adversary.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement is prompted, extended, slowed, interrupted, ranked, or stabilized by a controlling mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A horse's muzzle, the second runner, a stopping animal, a ship's rudder, and successive formation all encode controlled progression.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Slow and Interrupted Movement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A moving body twists or lags, then may halt and look back rather than complete an uninterrupted course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: slow winding run (د ع ع:B005/m01); slow travel (ي ت م:B004/m01); animal run interrupted by a backward stop (ك ذ ب:B007/m01); cessation of movement (س ك ن:B001/m01); calm stillness (س ه و:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Twisting gait and delayed travel weaken forward progress before the stopping animal makes interruption explicit. Stillness is the endpoint of the sequence, while the backward glance gives the halt a directional reversal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual pregnancy, loins, lung, marrow, failed milk, orphaned animals, and young stock resisting the year form a single husbandry horizon.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pregnancy, Milk, and Maternal Severance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Gestation becomes visible in body and udder, but milk may fail and the young animal may be cut off from its mother.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visible pregnancy (ر ء ي:B010/m01); enlarged udder (ر ء ي:B010/m02); milk yield that fails to persist (ك ذ ب:B006/m01); motherless animal (ي ت م:B001/m02); productive milk yield (ط ع م:B005/m03)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي, ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pregnancy is inferred from enlargement, and the udder carries an expectation of nourishment. Failed milk breaks that expectation, while maternal loss turns interrupted yield into a condition of dependency.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Herding and Seasonal Resilience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A herder calls young stock through a grazing landscape where water plants and forage allow them to withstand the year.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: herding call and rebuke (د ع ع:B003/m01); summer water plant grazed by cattle (د ع ع:B008/m01); camel forage grass (ص ل و:B009/m01); pasture that prevents migration (س ك ن:B010/m02); youthful camel or goat resisting the year (م ن ع:B007/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The call supplies human direction, pasture supplies the feeding setting, and youth supplies the animals' capacity to endure seasonal pressure. Resistance is physiological persistence rather than conflict with another agent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inattention and the Deceptive Self
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Attention leaves an obligation while the self supplies a misleading account of its own state or value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mental inattention (س ه و:B001/m01); neglect and shortcoming (ي ت م:B003/m01); deceptive self (ك ذ ب:B008/m01); loss of worth or responsiveness (ط ع م:B008/m02); attention and inquiry (ر ء ي:B013/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ (ر ء ي, ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Neglect is a withdrawal of attention, but self-deception obscures that withdrawal from the actor. The inquiry formula interrupts the closed loop by directing perception back toward conduct and consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Forbearance After a Stumble
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A faltering person is called to rise while another overlooks the lapse and answers with a restorative blessing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: restorative call to one who stumbles (د ع ع:B004/m01); wish or blessing to be raised (د ع ع:B004/m02); forbearance and overlooking another's slip (س ه و:B003/m01); prayer and blessing for another (ص ل و:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The stumble provides the lapse, the call supplies immediate direction, and forbearance prevents the lapse from becoming permanent exclusion. Blessing completes the recovery by turning rebuke into a wish for renewed standing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A word, surface, charge, yield, or motion is tested by whether appearance and expectation continue into actuality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: False speech extends into patterned cloth, failed milk, a broken charge, an animal that stops mid-run, and the contrasting image of action carried through without delay.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Failure to Persist
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An expected action or yield begins but breaks off before its promise is fulfilled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: failed or cowardly charge (ك ذ ب:B004/m01); milk yield that disappears (ك ذ ب:B006/m01); animal run interrupted by a stop and backward look (ك ذ ب:B007/m01); slow travel (ي ت م:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Charge, milk, and flight each create an expectation of continuation. Their premature ending gives falsehood a temporal form: the beginning announces a course that the outcome does not sustain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inquiry and Deictic Attention
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker summons an addressee's attention, points out a referent, and frames a request for identification or report.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: attention and inquiry formula (ر ء ي:B013/m01); demonstrative pointer (ذ و و:B003/m01); interrogative compound (ذ و و:B004/m01); relative connector (ذ و و:B002/m01); possession and attribution (ذ و و:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The attention formula opens the inquiry, the demonstrative fixes a target, and relative or possessive linkage identifies that target through relation. Questioning is therefore built as a sequence of orientation, pointing, and specification.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exhortation and Prohibitive Command
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker attempts to move another person toward an act or stop an act already contemplated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exhortation toward good or food (ح ض ض:B001/m01); battle incitement (ح ض ض:B001/m02); imperative to take up or adhere (ك ذ ب:B003/m01); prohibitive command (م ن ع:B005/m01); coercive redirection (د ع ع:B001/m02)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exhortation projects a desired action, the imperative presses immediate adherence, and prohibition blocks a competing course. Battle incitement and charitable urging reveal opposite practical ends carried by the same directive force.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Herding Call, Restorative Cry, and Lament
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A voiced formula reaches an animal, a fallen person, or a community in distress and attempts to orient the hearer to danger, movement, or recovery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: herding call and rebuke (د ع ع:B003/m01); restorative rise-call (د ع ع:B004/m01); blessing to be raised (د ع ع:B004/m02); lament cry (و ي ل:B002/m01); disgrace and calamity (و ي ل:B002/m02)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herding cry directs movement, the rise-call answers a stumble, and lament voices a calamity already present. Across the three settings, sound marks urgency and reorients attention toward an immediate condition.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi itme eyleminde birleşir; ancak sertlik, kabalık ve azarlama niteliği bütün aktarımlarda aynı ölçüde kurucu değildir. Bu yüzden dal, sıradan itme çekirdeğini koruyup sert ve kaba gerçekleşmeleri belirgin kullanımlar olarak ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel itmedir; sertlik ve azarlama bazı kullanımları daraltır, doldurma veya seslenme anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak itme çekirdeğiyle yapıya bağlı sertçe sürme ve azarlama örneklerini ayırır; özel yapılar bütün dalın anlamı sayılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi çobanın küçükbaş hayvanlara yönelttiği geleneksel sesi hem çağırma hem de azarlayıp yönlendirme işleviyle verir. Bazı aktarımlar koyunu genel olarak anarken bazıları özellikle keçiyi sınırlar; tanım bu kapsam farkını açık tutmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan yüksek ses değil, çobanın özellikle keçi veya küçükbaş sürüyü çağırmak ya da yönlendirmek için kullandığı sestir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Seslenme çekirdeği, keçiye yönelen yapı ve geleneksel çağrı biçiminden ayrılır; hayvana bağlı kullanımlar genel ses çıkarma anlamına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Çobanın küçükbaş hayvanları, özellikle keçileri, çağırmak veya azarlayarak yönlendirmek için geleneksel bir sesleniş kullanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Sesleniş, sürüyü çağırma veya davranışını yönlendirme amacı taşır.
Kullanım özellikle keçilere yönelir, ancak daha geniş küçükbaş sürü aktarımı da vardır.
Aynı geleneksel ses hem çağırma hem de azarlayıp sevk etme işlevi görebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar çoban sesinin sürüyü çağırma ve azarlayarak yönlendirme işlevinde birleşir; hayvan kapsamı genel küçükbaştan özellikle keçiye kadar değişir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çobanın küçükbaş hayvanı çağırma veya azarlama amacıyla ses kullandığı bütün dal için uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çağrının sürüyü durdurma, sevk etme veya davranışını düzeltme işlevinde uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, tökezleyen kişiye yöneltilen ikili bir sözün ayağa kalkma ve toparlanma işlevini açıkça verir. Bu, genel bir itme ya da genel bir teselli değil, belirli durumda kullanılan sözlü bir teşviktir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam tökezleyen muhataba söylenen kalıpla sınırlıdır; genel ayağa kalkma, yardım etme veya teselli etme anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca tökezleyen kişiye yöneltilen özel sözlü kalıbı açıklar; bundan çıplak bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

facets.statement: Söz doğrudan tökezleyen kişiye yöneltilir ve yeniden ayağa kalkmasını teşvik eder.
Ayağa kalkma buyruğuna toparlanma teşviki eşlik eder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli sözün tökezleyen kişiye yöneltilen teşvik işlevini eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.loses: Ayağa kalkma ve hemen toparlanma çağrısını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Hastalık veya yaralanma sonrasında kullanılan genel dileği ekler.
error_profile.collision: Türkçedeki hastalık ve kaza sonrası nezaket kalıbıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu yönü ayağa kalkma ve toparlanma çağrısıdır; komşu dal daha geniş bir durumda koruyucu esenlik dileği olarak kullanılabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi koşuyu iki eşzamanlı özellikle sınırlar: hareket doğrusal değil kıvrımlı veya dolambaçlıdır ve hızlı değil yavaştır. Dalın ayırıcı kimliği yalnızca koşma değil, bu özel hareket biçimidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yavaşlık ve kıvrımlı ilerleyiş birlikte kurucudur; sıradan koşu, ağır yürüyüş veya yorgunluktan sendeleme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kıvrımlı ve yavaş koşma anlamıyla sınırlıdır; komşu hareket biçimleri veya özel yapılar eklenmez.

facets.statement: Hareket yürüyüş değil koşudur ve ilerleme görece yavaştır.
Koşunun yolu ya da beden hareketi kıvrımlı ve dolambaçlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, koşunun kıvrımlı ilerleyişini ve yavaş temposunu birlikte kurucu özellikler olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem hareket türünü hem hızını hem de izlediği biçimi birlikte karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü kısa boylu adam için açıklar, fakat biçimin doğruluğunu koşullu verir ve başka bir biçimden ses değişimiyle gelmiş olabileceğini belirtir. Anlam korunabilir, ancak bağımsız ve üretken bir kök anlamı olduğu varsayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kısa boylu erkek kişiyi adlandırır; biçimin kökeni ve bağımsızlığı belirsiz olduğu için genel kısalık anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş sözcük birimi bulunmadığından dalın çıplak veya yapıya bağlı olduğu varsayılmaz; tanım yalnızca aktarılan kişi niteliğini kaydeder.

concept_map.definition: Kısa boylu bir erkeği niteleyen, biçimsel doğruluğu ve başka bir sözcükten ses değişimiyle gelip gelmediği belirsiz bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Adlandırmanın gönderimi kısa boylu erkek kişidir.
Biçimin başka bir kısa-boy adlandırmasından ses değişimiyle gelmiş olması mümkündür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca kısa boylu erkek gönderimini verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi iki yakın görünümü birlikte aktarır: iki hurma ağacı arasındaki açıklık ve seyrek duran hurma ağaçları. Ayrıca sözcüğün ilk ünsüzünün başka bir biçimde aktarılmış olabileceği belirtilir; bu nedenle dal hem yerleşim anlamını hem yazım belirsizliğini korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurmaların seyrekliği veya iki hurma arasındaki açıklıkla sınırlıdır; küçük hurma, toplu hurmalık ya da genel ağaçlık anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kabul edilmiş sözcük birimi bulunmadığından çıplaklık varsayılmaz; yalnızca seyrek hurmalar ve aralarındaki açıklık aktarılır.

concept_map.definition: Seyrek duran hurma ağaçlarını veya iki hurma ağacı arasında kalan açıklığı anlatan, ilk ünsüzü konusunda aktarım ayrılığı bulunan bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Hurma ağaçları bitişik bir topluluk değil, aralıklı ve seyrek durumdadır.
Adlandırma iki hurma ağacı arasında kalan boşluğa da uygulanır.
Sözcüğün ilk ünsüzü başka bir sesle aktarılmış bir biçime ait olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek aktarım seyrek hurmalar ile iki hurma arasındaki açıklığı aynı adlandırmada birleştirir ve biçim için bir ses varyantı kaydeder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın tohum anlamı, benzerlikle adlandırılan karınca ve tohum toplayan adamı bildiren özel yapıdan ayrılır; yapıdaki kişi anlamı çıplak dala taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim yabani bir bitkinin tohumudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ileri sürmesini temel alır; soy ve çocuk bağı iddiası ile savaşta soyunu bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı aynı iddia alanında özel biçimler olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hak ileri sürme, soy bağı kurma ve savaşta aidiyet bildirme ayrımları korunur; bunlar sıradan seslenme anlamına indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel hak ileri sürme biçimi ile soy ve savaş bağlamlarına bağlı yapılar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar yalın biçimin tamamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ya da aidiyet bağı ileri sürmesidir. Soy veya çocuk bağı kurma ve savaşta soyunu söyleyerek kendini tanıtma, bu iddia eyleminin özel biçimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir hak, kişinin kendisi ya da başka biri lehine ileri sürülür.
Bir çocuk veya kişi için soy bağı ileri sürülerek onu belirli bir babaya ya da soya bağlama anlamı vardır.
Savaş bağlamında kişi soyunu söyleyerek kendini ve bağlı olduğu topluluğu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia, hak ileri sürme çekirdeği yanında soy veya çocuk bağı kurmayı ve savaşta soy bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı birbirinden ayrılan özel gerçekleşmeler olarak kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak amacıyla memede bilerek bırakılan süt miktarını açıkça tanımlar; hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu amaç ve araç ilişkisini doğru korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan çerçeve bunu birine kötülük gelmesi için söz söyleme olarak sunarken kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı şeyi getirmesini ve olayın gerçekleşmesini anlatır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım sözlü dilekten gerçekleşen sıkıntıya kaydırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli yapıda Tanrı'nın istenmeyen bir şeyi kişinin başına getirmesidir; kötülük dileme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Düzeltilen anlam yalnızca verilen Tanrı, kişi ve istenmeyen sonuç yapısında geçerlidir; yalın çağırma anlamına genellenmez.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kişiye onun hoşlanmadığı bir şeyi yöneltir ve başına getirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, Tanrı'nın bir kişiye hoşlanmadığı şeyi indirmesi veya başına getirmesi sonucunu bildirir; sözlü bir kötülük dileme işlemi belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı süreci açıkça verir: duvarların birbiri ardından çökmesi ve yapıların birbiri ardından yıkılması. Hazırlanan çerçeve, ardışıklığı ve çökme ile ettirgen yıkma ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birbiri ardından gerçekleşme her iki kullanımda da kurucudur; tek bir çökme veya tek seferde yıkma dalın tamamını karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendiliğinden ardışık çöküş ile bir eyleyenin ardışık yıkması ayrı yapılara bağlı iki facet olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının parçalarının birbiri ardından çökmesi veya bir eyleyenin onları birbiri ardından yıkmasıdır. Her iki durumda da tek olay değil, birbirini izleyen bir bozulma dizisi vardır.

facets.statement: Yapısal bozulma tek seferde değil, parçaların birbirini izlemesiyle gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, ardışık çöküşü ve ardışık ettirgen yıkmayı aynı sıra ilişkisi altında birleştirir; eyleyenin bulunup bulunmaması iki kullanımı ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Kadına, babasını yitirmiş çocuklara verilen adla seslenilen kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır. Bir aktarım bu adın evlilikle sona erdiğini, diğeri ise evlilikten sonra da sürdüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: Kullanım, babasını yitirmiş çocuklara verilen adın kadın hakkında da söylenmesinden oluşur.
Bir aktarımda kadın evlenince bu adlandırma sona erer; karşıt aktarımda ise kadın bu adı hiçbir zaman yitirmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, kadınlara özgü bu kalıplaşmış adlandırmanın evlilikle ilişkili olduğunu, ancak kullanım süresinin tek biçimde aktarılmadığını gösterir.

source_details.summary: Bir aktarım adlandırmayı evlenene kadar sürdürürken diğeri evliliğin bu adı sona erdirmediğini bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: evlilikle sona erip ermediği tartışmalı kadın adlandırması
concept_gloss.applicability: Kadına yönelik bu özel adın evlilikten sonra sürüp sürmediğine ilişkin iki aktarımı birlikte özetlerken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına özgü adlandırmayı ve evlilik sonrası süre konusundaki karşıtlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.text: evlenene dek bu adla anılan kadın
contextual_glosses.applicability: Adlandırmanın kadının evlenmesiyle sona erdiğini kabul eden aktarımın bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına yönelik kullanımı ve evlilikte sona erme sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: evlendikten sonra da bu adla anılan kadın
contextual_glosses.applicability: Adlandırmanın evlilikten sonra da sürdüğünü kabul eden karşıt aktarımın bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına yönelik kullanımı ve evlilikten sonra sürme bilgisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: evlenene dek, başka bir aktarıma göre ise evlendikten sonra da babasını yitirmiş çocuk adıyla anılan kadın
kadınların babasını yitirmiş çocuk adıyla anılabileceğini bildiren söz

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kadınlara verilen özel bir addır ve bir aktarımda evlilikten sonra da sürebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kadın veya erkeğin fiilen eşsiz olmasını ve evlenmeden kalmasını doğrudan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadına verilen özel ad ile eşsiz olma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Evlenmemiş kadın, bir aktarımda iki kullanımın ortak bağlamında bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçek medeni durumu tanımlamak yerine özel bir adlandırmayı aktarır; komşu dal ise kişinin eşinin bulunmamasını cinsiyet ayrımı olmadan bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal evlilik öncesinde kullanılan ve bazı aktarımlarda evlilik sonrasında da süren bir kadın adlandırmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal eşten kopma, uzun süre eşsiz kalma ve evlenmeme durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kadın ve evlilik durumu çevresinde kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eşten ayrılmayı gerektirmez; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise eş bağının bulunmaması veya kesilmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kadın hakkındaki kalıplaşmış adlandırmayı ve süresine ilişkin aktarım ayrılığını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan çocuğunun babasını ergenlikten önce, hayvan yavrusunun ise annesini yitirmesiyle oluşan gerçek durumu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kadına verilen ad ile ebeveyn kaybı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kadına verilen ad, babasını yitirmiş çocuk için kullanılan adlandırmayla biçimsel olarak ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biçim ortaklığına rağmen odak dalda ebeveyn ölümü kurucu değildir; komşu dalda ise ebeveynin ölümü ve katılımcı ayrımı anlamın temelidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kadına yönelik özel bir adın evlilikle sona erip ermediğini tartışır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal eş olan erkeği, eş olan kadını ve eş olma ilişkisini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da evlilik ilişkisini çevreleyen söz varlığında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın içeriği adlandırmanın süresidir; komşu dalın içeriği ise eşin kendisi ve eş olma bağıdır, bu nedenle anlamsal örtüşme çok sınırlıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس اليتيم من الصبيان ولا كل منفرد من الأشياء ولا أم الأيتام
branches.source_phrase_ar: المرأة تدعى يتيما ما لم تتزوج فإذا تزوجت زال عنها اسم اليتم؛ يقال للمرأة يتيمة لا يزول عنها اسم اليتم أبدا (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, insan ve hayvanda belirli ebeveyn kaybını; tek kalma veya benzer azlığını; dalgınlık ile eksik davranmayı; yavaşlama ve gecikmeyi; ayrıca kadınlara yönelik, süresi tartışmalı bir adlandırma kalıbını kapsar. İlk iki alan ayrılma düşüncesiyle, son iki alan ise kaynaklardaki açıklayıcı yorumlarla ilişkilense de beş dalın sınırları birbirinden ayrıdır.
